blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – It is a “wake-up call” for lawmakers to finally pass a bill curbing political dynasties after the Supreme Court (SC) scolded Congress for failing to approve such a measure nearly four decades after the 1987 Constitution’s mandate, Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said on Wednesday. In a statement, Adiong said Congress must now “finish the work” by passing a bill outlawing political dynasties, which have long dominated elected posts across every rung of government. “Inaction is no longer defensible,” Adiong said.
